name: Neo4j
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the database and basic metadata extraction of node labels and relationship types.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can connect to Neo4j with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Neo4j, please validate the connection scheme, host, port and credentials.

steps.name: GetDatabases
steps.description: Resolve the database to extract, either the configured one or the user's home database.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to resolve the database, please validate that it exists and that the user can access it.

steps.name: GetNodeLabels
steps.description: List the node labels and their properties via db.schema.nodeTypeProperties().
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read node labels, please validate that the user can read the graph schema of the database.

steps.name: GetRelationshipTypes
steps.description: List the relationship types and their properties via db.schema.relTypeProperties().
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read relationship types, please validate that the user can read the graph schema of the database.
